product.title: Osaka & Nara in 1-Day by Private Van with Local Japanese Guide

description.text: In Kyoto, this private van day can hold Osaka, Nara, or both, with flexible pickup listed from Kyoto as well as Osaka or Nara hotels. An English-speaking guide and an air-conditioned Nissan van keep one group on published stops such as Todai-ji Temple, Nara Park, Kasuga-Taisha Shrine, and Osaka Castle. Fuel and highway fees are included; Todai-ji entry and meals stay separate. The published window is about six hours, with pickup and drop-off allowed at different cities. The format suits visitors basing in Kyoto who want a guided Nara or Osaka day without renting a highway car. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Kyoto, and the itinerary stays on Todai-ji, Nara Park, and Osaka Castle that shape this outing rather than a Fushimi Inari walking loop.
